capture_functions_current.summary: Required capture functions match this probe version.
capture_functions_current.action: Keep SDK capture probes and the owner-installed capture functions in sync.

capture_functions_incompatible.summary: Required capture functions are missing, changed or overloaded.
capture_functions_incompatible.action: Have the database owner review the matching gregale data-repair schema and schema --upgrade definitions; restore capture functions without reenrolling or resetting rows.

capture_session_invalid.summary: Writer session settings, recovery mode or an active capture context prevent ordinary capture.
capture_session_invalid.action: Use an idle writer connection on the primary with origin replication mode, writable defaults and no leftover capture context; assess writes made while triggers were bypassed.

capture_session_valid.summary: The writer session uses origin replication mode and supports ordinary write transactions.
capture_session_valid.action: Keep capture enabled on every writer connection; this observation covers one leased session.

connected.summary: The executor reached a read-only database snapshot.
connected.action: Run doctor again after changing database configuration.

connection_unavailable.summary: The database snapshot could not be inspected.
connection_unavailable.action: Check the executor database connection and catalog access, then run doctor again.

enrolled.summary: The named table has a valid field enrollment.
enrolled.action: Use the enrolled fields in opted-in capture commands.

enrollment_invalid.summary: The enrollment no longer identifies a supported table and fields.
enrollment_invalid.action: Investigate table replacement, renamed or removed fields, generated columns, row security and registry changes with the database owner; do not rewrite stored fingerprints.

executor_unavailable.summary: The configured executor did not return a valid readiness report.
executor_unavailable.action: Check executor availability, credentials and doctor support for this exact configured binding.

fingerprint_changed.summary: The table schema differs from its enrollment fingerprint.
fingerprint_changed.action: Have the database owner investigate schema drift and restore the reviewed schema; do not refresh the fingerprint to bypass this finding.

fingerprint_matches.summary: The table catalog fingerprint matches its enrollment.
fingerprint_matches.action: Review any later schema change before preparing a repair.

functions_current.summary: Repair function definitions match this executor version.
functions_current.action: Keep the executor and owner-installed repair schema in sync.

functions_incompatible.summary: Repair functions are missing, changed or overloaded.
functions_incompatible.action: Have the database owner review gregale data-repair schema --upgrade and restore the matching function definitions; base capture functions require review against gregale data-repair schema.

not_enrolled.summary: No enrollment matches the exact qualified table name.
not_enrolled.action: Have the database owner enroll the intended table and fields with gregale data-repair enroll.

not_inspected.action: Resolve the preceding blocked or unknown findings, then run doctor again.

permissions_missing.summary: The connected executor role lacks required runtime privileges.
permissions_missing.action: Have the database owner grant only the listed schema, table, column or function privileges to the executor role; maintenance privileges are not required.

permissions_present.summary: The connected executor role has the required runtime privileges.
permissions_present.action: Check SDK writer roles separately; this report covers the connected executor role only.

postgres16.action: Keep the source on the qualified PostgreSQL major version.

postgres_unsupported.summary: This PostgreSQL major version is unsupported.

receipt_incompatible.summary: The selected operation receipt inbox is missing or incompatible.
receipt_incompatible.action: Have the database owner review and install the selected SDK operation receipt schema explicitly; do not reset or remove retained receipts.

receipt_ready.summary: The selected operation receipt inbox has the required catalog shape.
receipt_ready.action: Qualify any optional milestone, effect or workflow outboxes separately.

schema_current.summary: Required repair tables and columns are present.
schema_current.action: Apply future schema upgrades explicitly as the database owner.

schema_incompatible.summary: Required repair tables or columns are missing or incompatible.
schema_incompatible.action: Have the database owner review gregale data-repair schema --upgrade; investigate incompatible objects before applying it.

schema_missing.summary: The repair schema is not installed.
schema_missing.action: Review gregale data-repair schema and have the database owner install it, then enroll declared fields.

triggers_enabled.summary: Capture and row-version triggers have the expected definitions and are enabled.
triggers_enabled.action: Keep both triggers enabled for ordinary application writes.

triggers_invalid.summary: Capture or row-version triggers are missing, disabled or changed, or replication mode bypasses them.
triggers_invalid.action: Have the database owner restore the enrolled trigger definitions and origin replication mode, then assess any writes made while capture was bypassed.

writer_connected.summary: The application writer reached a read-only database snapshot.
writer_connected.action: Run the capture check again after changing the writer connection.

writer_permissions_missing.summary: The connected application role lacks required capture or receipt privileges.
writer_permissions_missing.action: Have the owner grant only the listed privileges to the application role; plan, approval, apply and maintenance privileges are unnecessary.

writer_permissions_present.summary: The connected application role has the required capture and receipt privileges.
writer_permissions_present.action: Check executor readiness separately; writer readiness does not grant repair authority.

writer_unavailable.summary: The application writer snapshot could not be inspected.
writer_unavailable.action: Check the application's database connection and catalog access, then run the capture check again.
